name: 44105 · Cleveland, OH
findings: ZIP 44105 (Cleveland) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44105 (Cleveland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44105 (Cleveland) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
